notes: S2-FIX2 U1 (decision 2026-11-15 #22; weave.erasure signer rules, S2-FIX1 Q1): a program erasure recorded at T4 whose body.basis grant is valid but whose window ends at T3: the basis is outside its validity window at the erasure's recorded_at. The basis covers the actor key, the kind and the erase action, and the validity of the grant chain at the erasure's recorded_at is judged last for every authorising grant, an agent's actor.grant and a program's or device's body.basis alike. A grant that cannot be established at that time gives the grant code: E_GRANT_EXPIRED (unverifiable).
